description:
A lot of you have asked how I make these videos. Here's how: madeovernight.com

We work with the people at Overnight, and they've just released their app to the public. It's the app behind this channel: pick a topic, and it researches, writes, voices and builds the whole video, with sound and music, on your own Mac or PC. They're only taking 300 members.
LINK: madeovernight.com

How a Chinese spy got close to Jensen Huang, the boss of Nvidia, and how her company got billions of dollars of his chips to work for China.

Alice Huang ran Megaspeed, a Singapore company that bought Nvidia servers and kept them in Malaysia, where Chinese companies rented them over the internet. American intelligence was listening to her the whole time, and in her calls it found Jensen's name. For almost two years, nobody told him.

Who should have warned him?

0:00 Dinner in Singapore
0:41 The Man With the Key
4:31 The Locked Door
6:01 The Cover
7:17 The Approach
10:20 The Pipeline
11:49 What She Was After
15:39 The Memo
16:29 The Empty Chair

A lot of people have been asking how we make these videos. For inquiries into our process you can send us an email on: overnightstudiosi@gmail.com


Figures as of 9 November 2026, from reporting by The New York Times, the Financial Times, Bloomberg, CNBC and Reuters, and Nvidia's own statements.
